reusable_mathematical_lessons.validation: A proposed transfer must display one common full label, not a family of coordinate witnesses.

seven_field_mathematical_lesson.attempted_implication: Removing every local forced-MAGIC coordinate obstruction among h[0..7] at the least supported off-window cell might permit an actual H_31/P_32 common label.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.exact_result_or_failure: It does not. H_31 intersection P_32 is empty by a two-case universal syntax separator: p31=1 conflicts with parent pad h31=0; otherwise the a+=4 or 6 header forces p[7:10]=100, mapping to illegal parent index 00.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.mathematical_falsifier: One exact common label with a canonical UNSAT parent and canonical current word, or one current prefix outside both separator cases, refutes the certificate.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.proof_and_source_evidence: Five-step symbolic separator proof, exact support equations, and independently reimplemented public enumeration across 82928 unique prefixes counted per v. Computation corroborates rather than proves.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.repair_or_next_discriminator: Before moving to another k, classify full-word boundary coordinates and mapped token legality—not only the first eight MAGIC coordinates—and require a DifferenceWitness showing both k31 separators disappear.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.scope: Exact k31, parent (a,b,m)=(2,3,5), all three exact length64 current cells, unchanged C041/C048. No general-k, cover, circuit, or P-vs-NP implication.
seven_field_mathematical_lesson.supported_and_competing_causes: Supported cause is full-word canonical boundary/token legality. H_31 emptiness, missing current support, UNSAT semantics, and the old h0..h7 forced-MAGIC cause are excluded.
